purpose: The exhaustive list of Unit 202 evidence-authority-policy decisions that are genuinely, externally recorded as real Product Architect decisions (not self-declared by an acquisition/correction pass). Any `paAuthorityPolicyAdjudication` object embedded in a Batches 04-06 EVIDENCE-RESULTS.json row must have an `id` present in this registry's `decisions` array, or it is treated as an ungoverned, ad hoc field and must be removed or reclassified. This registry itself must never be edited to retroactively legitimise a field found during validation -- a new entry may only be added when a genuine, externally-recorded Product Architect decision actually exists (e.g. a PROJECT-STATUS.md entry, a DECISION-LOG.md entry, or equivalent).

decisions.scope: EDA-LP-25 (security-alarm-scr-thyristor-latching-sounder-role::EXACT_FACT) only -- the narrow relationship that a triggered, latched SCR can keep current flowing through an alarm bell/buzzer/sounder until current falls below holding current. Does NOT extend to any other Unit 202 requirement, does NOT restore the retired exact NC-loop/bias-detector topology, and does NOT authorise copying any specific circuit's component values or presenting the taught relationship as a compliant security-installation design.
decisions.externalRecord: The user's own third narrow-correction-pass instruction, 2026-09-06, Section F ("PRODUCT ARCHITECT DECISION FOR EDA-LP-25"), verbatim in substance: "for EDA-LP-25 only, Ray Marston's authored Nuts & Volts technical articles may be classified AUTHORITATIVE_TECHNICAL_REFERENCE for the narrow purpose of evidencing a representative SCR-and-bell/buzzer alarm application... Required mastery limited to: a trigger gates the SCR; the SCR latches; the SCR can keep current flowing through an alarm bell/buzzer/sounder; it remains conducting until current falls below holding current, commonly via supply interruption or reset." This instruction is this pass's external record, exactly as the CC-BATCH01 precedent above is externally recorded in PROJECT-STATUS.md -- both are genuine records made by a party external to (and prior to) the acquisition/correction work itself, not self-declared mid-acquisition.
decisions.rationale: The qualification requires a representative introductory exemplar of the SCR-latching-plus-sounder application, not a normative security-installation design. Ray Marston's Nuts & Volts articles ("SCR Principles and Circuits", Jan 2002; "Security Electronics Systems and Circuits" Part 4, 1998 -- both independently confirmed on his own contributor page, https://www.nutsvolts.com/magazine/contributor/ray_marston) are authored technical treatments with explicit circuit diagrams, not anonymous hobbyist forum posts. Manufacturer evidence (Littelfuse AN1002) remains the authority for SCR gating/latching/holding-current mechanics; the magazine supplies only the alarm-bell/buzzer application relationship that no manufacturer or standards source states.
boundaries: Does not restore the retired exact NC-detector/bias topology (security-alarm-exact-nc-contact-bias-topology remains RETIRED_OUT_OF_SCOPE).
Does not authorise copying either article's specific circuit values (resistor values, SCR/transistor part numbers beyond the generic device roles already evidenced) into taught content.
Does not represent the taught relationship as a compliant, installable security-alarm design.
Composes transparently alongside, and does not supersede, the existing manufacturer evidence (Littelfuse AN1002) for gating/latching/holding-current.

structuralPolicyNote: Unit 202's genuine, code-enforced widening of the OPERATIONAL_USE_RULE mode (UNIT202_SOURCE_AUTHORITY_POLICY in scripts/backtests/unit202-evidence-acquisition-preflight/unit202-adapter.ts) is NOT modelled as a per-row paAuthorityPolicyAdjudication object at all -- it is baked directly into the frozen evidence-requirement plan's own sourceAuthorityClasses field for exactly Unit 202's three OPERATIONAL_USE_RULE targets (the right-hand grip rule and the two Fleming rules), enforced by a fail-closed invariant (assertUnit202DirectionalRuleInvariant) that refuses planning if the premise (exactly 3 targets, exactly the same dimension set) ever breaks. Because it is structural and plan-level, it is already covered by the existing plan/result field-equality check and needs no separate registry entry.
